result: A nonmonotone equality line search finds very large GD steps that run at the edge of stability yet still converge to stationarity. But the flattest region is not the goal: in MSE classification sharpness bottoms out at 2/K on dead-end saddles.
result_plain: Nonmonotone line search: large EoS steps that converge; the 2/K sharpness floor marks flat dead-end saddles.
